tap.mechanism: 68010 program-space memory tap installed after frame 10, when init_adsp() has dynamically installed the handler

observation: Direct memory taps in independent 600-frame no-input and coin_start runs observe 5456 program-window writes in each run, all from 68010 PC 0x02D35C, covering 0x800000-0x807ff6. The caller at 0x02C204 reads the same 32-bit source pointer 0x0001702E from $17000 and passes it to 0x02D2E0 in both runs. The static listing shows 0x02D35C as MOVE.L D0,(A2)+; the preceding code derives A2 from 0x800000 plus a decoded offset and builds D0 from the encoded byte stream at 0x1702E. This identifies the runtime writer and source pointer, but not the source buffer's semantic ownership or a normalized instruction-level decode of the bus-lane bytes.
confidence: MAME-CONFIRMED window plus OBSERVED-IN-TRACE writer PC and transfer range
notes: The tap reports bus-level write events; paired halfword events arise from the 68010 MOVE.L transfer and are not yet normalized into instruction-level longwords.
The next experiment correlates the decoded source bytes/table at 0x02D304-0x02D364 with the resulting ADSP image and checks the ADSP data/control window.
